text:
Maya Chen: Proposal for Optimize toolkit MVP: focus on practical wins for pilots. Deliverables: (A) adaptive batching + prefix KV cache, (B) eval-triggered alerting (regression detection on canonical prompt sets), (C) light pilot docs. Defer quant recommendations to follow-up unless we can do a very small advisory.

Danielle Rivera: +1 to deferring quant feature. We still need clear go/no-go criteria though. Can we define measurable gates for econ, latency, and alert fidelity?

Ajay Patel: From infra: adaptive batching is doable in 2 sprints if we scope admission control small. Prefix caching is low-risk. Alerting needs the eval hook and thresholds; we can wire evaluation jobs to existing metrics pipeline. Quant recs require offline eval infra + model sampling which is bigger.

Leo Wong: Suggest these acceptance criteria: econ: >=15% avg token cost reduction on pilot routes over a 7-day window; latency: p95 no worse than +10% over baseline; alerting: precision >=80% on known regressions (we'll validate with seeded tests). If any gate fails, pause rollout.

Sasha Kumar: Pilot customers (NoteFlow, BeaconDocs) pushed for quant recs, but both are okay taking a "beta advisory" PDF if we promise roadmap. I'll coordinate expectations.

Maya Chen: OK Sasha to own pilot comms. We should create a one-pager for quant advisory that includes caveats and a sample config snippet.

Ajay Patel: Implementation sketch for adaptive batching admission control:
```json
{"max_wait_ms":"30","min_batch_size":"3","prefer_latency_percentile":"p50"}
``` 
We'll run with synthetic traces -> small canary -> wider pilot.

deploy-bot: Canary cluster created for optimize-toolkit in eu-west-1 with 4 nodes. Monitoring: /services/optimize-toolkit/canary. Alerts posted to #eng-oncall.

Danielle Rivera: Launch gates proposal: 1) bench results on 3 representative prompt sets, 2) alert precision/recall validated with seeded regressions, 3) pilot onboarding playbook & UI toggle for batching per-route, 4) telemetry dashboards for econ.

Leo Wong: Add business rule: measure econ delta in first 72 hours; if less than 8% improvement, auto-roll back batching on that route. Also capture user-visible latencies to ensure no regressions.

Maya Chen: Timeline: infra spike this week (Ajay), acceptance checklist doc (Danielle) by Wed, quant advisory draft (Sasha) by Thu EOD, econ dashboards (Leo) by Fri. We'll aim for pilot rollout next week.

Sasha Kumar: I'll post a draft advisory and a sample quant config:
```
# sample experimental quant config
model: gpt-medium-8bit
notes: "experimental, may degrade rare-case outputs"
```
ETA Thu.

Ajay Patel: I'll start spike and post results in thread. Need a small feature flag for batching toggle.

Maya Chen: Decision: MVP scope = adaptive batching + prefix cache + eval alerts + pilot docs. Quantization recommendations = separate advisory doc, not bundled in runtime v1. Action owners and dates noted above. :rocket:
